verdict.rationale: Docs describe e-signing of documents (docs-22, docs-37) and explicitly state that stock certificates and other documents are tied to the corresponding award agreement, board consent, and exercise actions (docs-34), plus a smart-linking feature connecting cap table entries to data-room documents (docs-7, docs-8). This directly supports issuing signed certificates linked to cap table records. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of certificate issuance workflow, explicit legal-validity/e-sign compliance details (e.g., ESIGN Act), and confirmation that the link is truly permanent/immutable rather than just dynamically updated
